text: [Image #1] still getting some faces getting corrupted with losing color or whatever it is
resolution: Confirmed the dark cylinder wedges were opaque black pixels baked from transparent atlas padding during topology carry, not missing faces. Atlas carry now copies RGB only across the old/new face-silhouette intersection and preserves current authored opacity. Added a Zig boundary regression for changed silhouettes and verified 42 paint tests, 45 mesh-edit tests, and the ReleaseFast editor build.
